report_identity.report_title: Chinney Kin Wing Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: 集团在香港从事地基建筑及相关服务、钻探及地盘勘测工程。
business_overview.revenue_model: Construction services revenue is recognised over time using an input method; payment is generally due within 30 days from billing and customers retain part of payment until the retention period ends.
business_notes: Revenue is entirely from Hong Kong construction services in 2025.
Two major customers contributed HK$663.242m and HK$560.212m revenue respectively.
The group had HK$237.410m corporate guarantees and counter-indemnities for performance bonds in the ordinary course of business.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest earned on cash/time deposits; excluded from owner earnback operating profit when principal is treated as detachable funds.

non_recurring_items.item: Interest income from loan to related company
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest on HK$250m connected loan; excluded from owner earnback operating profit when principal is treated as detachable financial asset.
Small foreign exchange gain, not core construction operating profit.
Equipment disposal loss; treated as small non-core item.

funds_assets.business_substance: Unpledged bank cash; disclosed as cash and bank balances and part of cash equivalents.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 notes 20 and Financial Review, pp.99,33

funds_assets.item: Non-pledged time deposits with original maturity less than three months
funds_assets.business_substance: Short-term bank time deposits; non-pledged and held with creditworthy banks.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 note 20 and cash flow statement, pp.99,54

funds_assets.business_substance: Unsecured 6% connected loan to Chinney Investments, extended for a further 12 months; amortised-cost financial asset, not operating construction asset.

operating_assets.business_substance: Construction receivables, mostly short credit period but with overdue exposure.
Unbilled revenue and retention receivables from construction contracts.
Construction plant, machinery, vehicles and equipment.
Leasehold land and leased land used in operations.
Operating prepayments/deposits; includes HK$8.653m deposits for PPE acquisition.

other_assets.business_substance: No tax recoverable balance at 31 Dec 2025.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, p.50

financing_liabilities.business_substance: IFRS lease liability; no bank borrowings disclosed, but lease liability is interest-bearing financing-like liability.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables and retention payables for construction work.
Accrued operating costs and payables; part of financial liabilities included in other payables/accruals.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 note 22 and note 31, pp.101,105

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, p.50

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred tax liabilities, mainly accelerated tax depreciation.
Contingent guarantees/counter-indemnities for performance bonds, ordinary course but requires liquidity capacity.

years.source: Annual Report 2025 and 2024 comparative statements, pp.53-54 / p.83
Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement and notes 6,14,19, pp.53-54,83,89,99

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2023-2025 operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit every year, but construction receivables/contract assets remain large and the business requires continuous machinery capex. Owner-earnback profit excludes interest on detachable funds and applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut for project-cycle, customer concentration, retention and capex risks.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of profit or loss, p.48
Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement, p.53

evidence.metric: PPE capex plus PPE deposits cash outflow
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement, p.53

gaps: 年报未按上市母公司、香港子公司、澳门/新加坡子公司拆分现金所在主体；现金折扣按香港经营集团但保留子公司分红和经营占用折价。
年报未披露每笔现金/定存银行名称和币种；仅披露存放于信用良好银行且无质押。
未披露履约保函是否占用银行授信保证金；作为流动性限制和必要现金考虑，不把或有保证全额视为债务。
未披露维持性资本开支和增长性资本开支拆分；以近年PPE新增和管理层资本付款说明估算维持性需求。
